items.title: Peka B40 Screenings Reveal Undiagnosed Conditions Among Almost Half Of Participants
items.summary: Nearly 46% of 328,302 people screened by Peka B40 last year had either at least one previously undiagnosed NCD, identified as being at risk of anxiety or depression, or both. Peka B40 screening uptake as of Aug 31 varied from 15% in KL to 46% in Kelantan. items.title: Pantai Hospital KL Pioneers Mahjong Programme To Help Curb Alzheimer’s
items.summary: Pantai Hospital KL is the first hospital to integrate competitive social mahjong into a clinical brain health programme, offering participants a unique combination of expert medical dialogue, digital cognitive assessments, and interactive social gameplay. items.title: Heat, Haze Squeeze Livestock Farmers As Egg Output Falls
items.summary: Livestock farmers in Malaysia are spending more to protect animals from heat and haze, as some report lower egg, poultry, and milk production. Experts caution that haze alone cannot explain the losses. The post Heat, Haze Squeeze Livestock Farmers As Egg Output Falls appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Doctor No-Shows For Permanent Posts Hit Sabah, Sarawak
items.summary: On Sept 28, many medical officers (MOs) didn’t report for duty for permanent posts in Sabah and Sarawak. Doctors unofficially reported zero MOs showing up in at least four hospitals; other facilities in both states reportedly saw 70% to 76% no-shows. items.title: Dr Hasmah, In Retrospect — Dr Loshi Rajen
items.summary: There is an old photo of Dr Hasmah driving a red Proton Saga across the Penang Bridge. The first car I ever knew was my father's Saga. Years later, looking through these photos, I would see her behind the wheel of one and feel a moment of borrowed pride.
